name: Klann Plastics

about:
Klann Plastics operates from Waynesboro, Virginia, where it was founded in 1910 by August Klann as a builder of pipe organs. By the mid-20th century, scarcity of ivory for organ keys led Klann to explore plastic injection molding, transforming the company's tool shop into a mold-building operation and launching more than 75 years of molding expertise.

Today the company runs a versatile fleet of molding machines ranging from 40 to 315 tons, producing components from a few grams to roughly two pounds. As a fully custom injection molder with no proprietary products, Klann provides plastic injection molding, insert and over-molding, medical clean room molding in Class 10,000 environments, mold design and build, metal-to-plastic conversions, short-run production, mold transfer, and inventory management. Production volumes span from hundreds to millions of units annually.

The firm serves medical device OEMs as a UL-recognized, FDA-listed contract manufacturer, along with government research agencies and a broad base of Fortune 500 and regional industrial customers. Documented projects include feedthrough guides for government research and protocol studies for medical component materials.

Klann differentiates itself through in-house mold design and maintenance using SolidWorks, Master Unit Die (MUD) systems, ISO 9001:2015 certification, and a commitment to responsive service and long-term partnerships—principles rooted in its original pivot from organ building to plastics innovation.
